title: VTG Barn Dinner Theatre Program Owl and the Pussycat Dawn Wells Dallas TX
descriptionText: The product is a vintage dinner theatre program from the Barn Dance Dinner Theatre in Dallas, Texas, featuring the play "Owl and the Pussycat" with actress Dawn Wells. This playbill is a piece of entertainment memorabilia that captures a specific production within the theater industry. It serves as a nostalgic keepsake for fans of theater and would make a unique addition to any collection of playbills or theater memorabilia.
